observed_before: FIELD APPLY and REMOVE were the same hidden toggle operation.
LensState normalization could coerce explicit invalid kind/authority/operator values into valid-looking defaults before validation.
FieldLensAPI still exposed peer() even after G2 removed PEER from the visible Lens, leaving a latent SELECT backdoor.
Generic route Lens exposed a no-op STACK control and route-only RETURN called browser BACK.
Generic Lens trigger used ⊗ even though ⊗ already denotes COMPOSE; FIELD used ◎.
Scale Studio visible RETURN used the true caller resolver while ScaleLensSpatialAPI.return() still used an older address/history fallback.
A successful v2 Studio handoff left the simultaneously-written legacy fallback key behind, allowing stale later re-consumption.
delta: APPLY and REMOVE are separate idempotent FIELD adapter commands.
Explicit invalid LensState enum values survive normalization and are rejected at validation boundaries; omitted values retain lawful defaults.
FieldLensAPI.peer is removed; route SELECT remains host-owned.
Focus Ring publishes truthful disclosure/view ARIA state and restores invocation focus when possible.
Generic Toolglass replaces dead STACK with COPY STATE and route-only RETURN closes Lens without navigation.
Portable Lens trigger is consistently ◎; ⊗ remains composition semantics.
ScaleLensSpatialAPI.return() delegates to the same returnToCaller() resolver as visible Studio controls.
v2 handoff consume clears both v2 and legacy fallback keys.

lens_browser: PASS LENS STACK STUDIO RETURN via ScaleLensSpatialAPI.return()
proof.attribution: Aggregate workflow attempt 2 is red only because DOCS RSVP focus kernel timed out; every Lens-specific case passed. Attempt 1 terminated on a browser-process timeout at the first '/' smoke before reaching product cases. No DOCS code is modified by this branch.

invariants_preserved: Lens owns APERTURE / VIEW / STACK / RETURN.
BACK is navigation; RETURN restores or exits Lens state and is not disguised browser history.
stop_condition: Ship this bounded hardening after final-head checks. Then use Lens normally; reopen architecture only for a repeated concrete deficit such as genuinely reused compound presets or a task-specific projection with paired evidence of benefit.
